question: In 1898, whose theory propounded that the ions/groups bonded to the metal by secondary bonding have spatial arrangements corresponding to different characteristics coordination numbers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alfred Werner. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alfred Werner theory** propounded that the ions/groups bonded to the metal by secondary bonding have spatial arrangements corresponding to different characteristics coordination number.
 
• He was Swiss chemist and winner of the** Nobel Prize for Chemistry in 1913** for his research into the structure of coordination compounds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Henry Taube** was a Canadian-born American chemist.

 
 
• He was awarded the 1983 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for "his work in the mechanisms of electron-transfer reactions, especially in metal complexes.
 
 
 
• **Erich Armand Arthur Joseph Hückel** was a German physicist and physical chemist.
 
 
• He is known for two major contributions:
 
 
• The Debye–Hückel theory of electrolytic solutions
 
• The Hückel method of approximate molecular orbital calculations on π electron systems.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Hermann Emil Louis Fischer** was a German chemist and 1902 recipient of the Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
 
 
• He discovered the Fischer esterification.
